violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: GRILLED CHICKEN.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. PIC AGREED TO DISCONTINUE NON-COOKING PROCESS. EHS WILL PROVIDE PIC WITH MORE INFORMATION REGARDING THE NON-CONTINUOUS COOK PROCESS IF THE FACILITY WISHES TO CONTINUE THE PROCESS IN THE FUTURE.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Ceasing Operations & Reporting (Voluntary for Imminent Health Hazard)
violations.observation: The permit holder failed to discontinue operations and notify the Health Department that an imminent health hazard may exist because of an emergency. OBSERVED ACTIVE SEWAGE BACKUP FROM FLOOR DRAIN AT THREE-VAT SINK DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: FACILITY CONTACTED A PLUMBER DURING THE INSPECTION WHO WILL COME TO REPAIR BACKUP AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. PLEASE CONTACT THE EHS WHEN THE FACILITY IS READY TO REOPEN.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED AN ACTIVE SEWAGE BACKUP FROM FLOOR-DRAIN AT THREE-VAT SINK WHEN WATER IS RELEASED FROM A COMPARTMENT OR WHEN DISHWASHING MACHINE IS RAN.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. THE FACILITY WILL ENSURE THE BACKUP IS REMEDIATED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND WILL CONTACT THE EHS WHEN THEY ARE READY TO REOPEN.
